item.title: Go Daily Question 105
item.description:
What is the output value of counter in the following code?

func main() {
    var m = map[string]int{
        "A": 21,
        "B": 22,
        "C": 23,
    }
    counter := 0
    for k, v := range m {
        if counter == 0 {
            delete(m, "A")
        }
        counter++
        fmt.Println(k, v)
    }
    fmt.Println("counter is ", counter)
}
  • A. 2
  • B. 3
  • C. 2 or 3
🔑 Answer Analysis:

C Maps are reference types and will affect the original map.

item.title: Go Daily Question 058
item.description:
What is the output of the following code?

func incr(p *int) int {
    *p++
    return *p
}

func main() {
    p :=1
    incr(&p)
    fmt.Println(p)
}
  • A. 1
  • B. 2
  • C. 3
🔑 Answer Analysis:

Answer: B.

Key takeaway: Pointers. p in the incr() function is a pointer of type *int, pointing to the address of the variable p in the main() function. The second line of code performs an increment operation on the value at that address. incr() returns the result after the increment.
